frozen_source.source_change_rule: Any change after parent_revision under the runner source scope invalidates execution. Experiment evidence and preregistration files are outside that scope.

model_condition.replicate_identifier_scope: Seeds control local ordering only; equal identifiers do not pair provider-side draws.

predeclared_decision_rules.protocol_valid: All six task-mode-replicate runs complete eight proposals with trusted secure evaluation, exact preregistration binding, and no infrastructure failure.
predeclared_decision_rules.measures_iteration_candidate: The repository report_admission_criterion analyzer finds the selection-blind control saturated away from floor and ceiling and a material positive normal-minus-selection-blind gap robust to leaving out one replicate.
predeclared_decision_rules.sampling_dominated_or_unresolved: The selection-blind control remains materially increasing, the feedback gap is non-positive or not leave-one-out robust, or the analyzer verdict remains unknown.
predeclared_decision_rules.disposition: Only a measures_iteration_candidate result can support retaining this wave as a hard iterative-search candidate. Otherwise keep it uncalibrated or redesign the search cell; do not rescue it by hiding public inputs or tightening score thresholds.
predeclared_decision_rules.budget_twelve: Do not launch budget twelve from this protocol. Make a new preregistration only if budget eight is technically complete but scientifically ambiguous for a reason named before inspecting additional model outputs.
